method_overview: Three meta-analytic combinations of the 4 H10 sample-size p-values, all in the REFUTATION direction (Joint > Frozen).

fisher_combined_p.interpretation: NOT significant; combined null NOT rejected

framework_implication.P4_cross_task_consistency: SUPPORTED -- REFUTATION direction consistent across 4 sample sizes AND 2 task families (simple-arith and GSM8K-200-token)
framework_implication.P2_h10_consistency: SUPPORTED -- all 4 sample sizes and all 3 meta-analytic combinations yield non-significant F-J contrast in the REFUTATION direction
framework_implication.R3_replication_overturn: NOT OBSERVED -- H10 REFUTATION survives 4 replications

bonferroni_holm_step_down.method: Holm 1979 step-down procedure, FWER controlled at alpha=0.05
bonferroni_holm_step_down.conclusion: NONE of the 4 H10 sample-size tests rejects the null under Bonferroni-Holm at alpha=0.05. Consistent with Bonferroni-min-p result in v1.1.

hedges_g.method: Hedges g bias-corrected Cohen d, J = 1 - 3/(4(n-1) - 1)
hedges_g.conclusion: All 4 Hedges g confidence intervals span zero, consistent with p-value analysis.

forest_plot.description: Forest plot of 4 H10 sample-size Cohen d with 95% CI; vertical lines at d=0 and d=+0.10 (kill switch threshold).
forest_plot.visual_conclusion: All 4 d estimates straddle 0; pre-reg kill switch threshold NOT crossed; H10 REFUTED.

v1_2_extension.conclusion_summary: Extended meta-analysis (Bonferroni-Holm + Hedges g + forest plot) is consistent with v1.1 conclusion: H10 REFUTED across all sample sizes and task families. P2 and P4 supported; R3 NOT observed.
